title: Between the Lines Grape to Glass Wine Experience
includes: Gratuities are not included, but are encouraged.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We’re proud of our work and happy to show it off at Between The Lines Winery & Vineyard. Follow the journey from Grape to Glass in a safe & refreshing experience. We'll tell you all about the history of Between the Lines Winery, you'll get a crash course on the vine itself & learn what it takes to grow the grapes from dormancy to harvest. Next, you'll head to the cellar where you'll learn about our winemaking process from fruit selection to fermentation. This experience is approximately 45 minutes and four wine tastings are included.

Between the Lines Winery does not provide transportation. Arrive at the winery at your reservation start time.
